description: Gets a tournament's bracket by league code: for each division, each pool's table, then every knockout slot with where its two sides come from ("winner of group A", "winner of match 49"), the teams filling them once decided, the games played in it and who went on. Answers "who plays whom next in the World Cup", "who is left in the NBA Cup" and "who plays for fifth in the Players Era".

code.description: The league's code, in any case (FWWC, nba).

season.description: The tournament's page slug (players-era-2026) or a season slug (2026-2027, its newest tournament), or null for the league's newest.

name: get_league_bracket

divisions.description: Its divisions, in the order a page shows them: one for most tournaments.

key.description: The division's key in its tournament (players-era-8, or main).

name.description: The division's own name where a tournament has several (Players Era 16); null otherwise.

advance.description: How many of its places go straight through.

complete.description: Whether every pool game is final, so its places are settled.

rows.description: Its rows, best first; empty before its teams are drawn.

drawn.description: Its draws; zero where games can't be drawn.

points.description: Table points where the competition awards them (soccer's three for a win); null where it ranks on wins.

rounds.description: The knockout rounds in playing order, as keys a page words (round-of-16, places-5-8, final).

slots.description: Every knockout slot, each after the slots that feed it.

advancing.description: The team that went on, once settled.

kind.description: placed (Pool, Place), winner or loser (Slot), seed (Section, Seed), ranked (Pools, Place, Rank), or bye.

place.description: Its place in that pool, or in each of Pools.

pools.description: The pools it is ranked across.

section.description: The section a seed is drawn in.

slot.description: The slot it wins or loses.

date.description: The day it is scheduled for, in the tournament's zone; null when it waits on who hosts it.

delayReason.description: Why the game was moved, if it was.

abbreviation.description: Three letters, for where even the short name will not fit.

shortName.description: The name for a narrow cell, such as "Guardians".

slug.description: The club's address within its league, from the stored name, as Slug.

key.description: The game's permalink key (2026-10-24-1840-vs-houston-astros), where the read states it; null elsewhere.

score.description: A Final's score as {home}-{away}; null for a live, unplayed or unfinished game.

startTime.description: The start time in UTC; the server never localises it.

abbreviation.description: Three letters, for where even the short name will not fit.

shortName.description: The name for a narrow cell, such as "Guardians".

slug.description: The club's address within its league, from the stored name, as Slug.

kind.description: placed (Pool, Place), winner or loser (Slot), seed (Section, Seed), ranked (Pools, Place, Rank), or bye.

place.description: Its place in that pool, or in each of Pools.

pools.description: The pools it is ranked across.

section.description: The section a seed is drawn in.

slot.description: The slot it wins or loses.

editions.description: Every tournament this league has a bracket for, oldest first.

name.description: The tournament's own name where it isn't the league's (Emirates NBA Cup); null otherwise.

season.description: The season slug it is filed under.

slug.description: The page's segment under the league: emirates-nba-cup-2026.

endsOn.description: Its last day, in its own zone, as far as its format says.

name.description: The tournament's own name, as its organiser writes it, where it isn't its league's; null otherwise.

season.description: The season slug it is played in.

slug.description: The bracket page's segment under its league (emirates-nba-cup-2026).

startsOn.description: Its first day, in its own zone, as far as its format says.

state.description: How far the whole tournament has got: finished once every division is.

tag.description: The feed title's tag (NBA Cup); null for a tournament that is its league.

title: League bracket
